title: 1992 Leaf #445 Jeff Kent Rookie Toronto Blue Jays Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
1992 Leaf Series 2 #445 Jeff Kent, Toronto Blue Jays - from his 1992 rookie season (back reads "No Major League Record"). Later the 2000 NL MVP and a Hall of Fame second baseman.

Ships in an eBay Standard Envelope.
